generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Consortium / Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka.

The Tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
EMD payments through e-payment mode shall be as single transaction and payment made in part are liable for rejection.

The Bidder shall scan the Bank Guarantee towards EMD over and above Rs.10.00Lakh as per Annexure-II of Section-4 and upload the same in the prescribed format in the e-procurement portal to enable the owner for verification of EMD BG at the time of opening of Techno Commercial Bid, failing which the offer will be rejected. Also, the Bidder shall ensure that the Bank Guarantee towards EMD shall be sent in original to the Chief Engineer, Electy., (T&P), KPTCL, Bengaluru, so as to reach after the last date of submission of bid & on or before the date & time notified for opening of Techno Commercial Bids, in a sealed cover, failing which their bid will not be opened.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
Tenderer shall upload the legible documents only.
Bidder shall not take any deviations on the clauses listed in the No Deviation Certificate (Annexure-I) & Schedule 5 and Schedule 6.

Please note that the Filled in Techno commercial sheet shall be uploaded along with all other QR documents. Offers shall be quoted in the item-wise bid Financial offer, provisioned in the e-procurement portal. In case the Prices are uploaded in/along the Techno commercial Bid, then Bid will be summarily rejected. The Techno-commercial sheets shall be uploaded in KPTCL excel formats only.
All other terms and conditions as per Tender documents.

POWER TRANSFORMERS: 
150 MVA, 220/66/11 kV  Power Transformer, 3 Ph, 50 Hz, Core type, 2 winding  Transformer star/star/delta, vector group: Ynyn0d11, OLTC, bushing CT for tertiary of ratio 1515/1 A, 5P20, 15VA, ONAN/ONAF/OFAF with fan control cubicle, Numerical RTCC panel with optic fibre temperature sensor/FOTMS,  oil etc., complete  with 2x50% seperate radiator bank on left side and terminal connectors suitable for single Drake ACSR on primary & double Drake ACSR on secondary side of transformer and Neutral connectors suitable for 2 Nos of 75mm x 10mm copper flats etc., along with 10 % spare oil in non-returnable drums, etc., complete with 2x50% separate radiator bank on left side as per technical specification.  
Note:
1. The existing NIFPS shall be used. Any modifications (such as pipe line extension or reduction, etc.) required to connect the proposed 150 MVA to the existing NIFPS system is in the scope.                                                                                           2. The existing oil sump capacity if insufficient to meet the requirement of NIFPS for 150 MVA Transformer shall be modified accordingly.

SF-6 circuit breakers with rigid, bi-metallic terminal connector suitable for Drake ACSR conductor/Aluminium pipe with spring/semi pneumatic/ pneumatic type operating mechanism with mounting structure complete as per technical specifications. 
66  kV, 2000 A, 40 kA SF6 CB

(for HV side of transformer and 66kV Bus coupler).

66 kV, 2000 A, 40 kA class 
1) Upright mounting type without Earth Switch LPH 5550 mm
